sanskrit_verse:
पटे वा ताम्रपट्टे वा स्वमुद्रोपरिचिह्नितम् ।
अभिलेख्यात्मनो वंश्यान् आत्मानं च महीपतिः ॥३१९॥
transliteration:
paṭe vā tāmrapaṭṭe vā svamudroparicihnitam /
abhilekhyātmano vaṃśyān ātmānaṃ ca mahīpatiḥ // YajñS_1.319
sph_interpretive_translation: The king shall cause to be inscribed upon cloth or copper plate, marked with his own seal, a record of his lineage, his descendants, and himself.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority as Self-Certification through Symbolic Continuity
Causation via Lineage Documentation for Governance Legitimacy
Capacity-based responsibility rooted in Royal Identity Preservation
Restoration logic through Public Record Maintenance
Consciousness alignment by Sovereign Historical Continuum
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler EXISTS AND legitimacy CLAIMED THEN documentation ON durable medium REQUIRED
IF seal USED THEN identity VERIFICATION through registry MANDATORY
IF lineage ASSERTED THEN public inscription VALIDATES sovereignty
IF governance AUTHORITY invoked THEN historical continuity MUST be preserved
IF succession DISPUTED THEN sealed records serve as prima facie evidence OF continuity
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning royal succession or sovereign legitimacy, the Supreme Court shall recognize inscriptions bearing the sovereign's seal on imperishable media as prima facie proof of documented lineage and self-certified identity, overriding oral claims unless proven to supersede written continuity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through indelible inscription; anupūrvaśaḥ manifests in unbroken genealogical sequence; proportional responsibility lies in truthful representation; dharma prevails when identity aligns with documented truth—punishment absent, integrity restored.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: ensure all future rulers inscribe genealogy under official seal
Responsibility assumption protocol: current ruler confirms accuracy of ancestral record
Capacity restoration: educate royal household on preservation of lineage documents
Integrity reintegration: validate existing seals against known authentic impressions
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared: This law proceeds from the eternal Dharma, sourced in sovereign self-certification. No punishment arises therefrom, only restoration of rightful continuity. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
